eyebrow: One line is the whole gate
code:
deploy-prod:
  needs: deploy-staging
  environment: production   # 1 required reviewer
  steps:
    - uses: azure/login@v2
      with:
        client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}

    - uses: azure/aks-set-context@v4
      with:
        resource-group: rg-northbridge-prod
        cluster-name: northbridge-aks-prod

    - run: |
        helm upgrade --install checkout ./charts/checkout \
          --namespace northbridge-prod \
          --values ./charts/checkout/values-prod.yaml \
          --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }}
caption: The job pauses at "environment: production" until GitHub records an approval
